Required if the title or branch names an issue (#N, fix-N, issue-N):
  Closes #N   (also Fixes / Resolves) - the issue closes when this merges
  Refs #N     - related, must NOT close the issue
"(#N)" in the title does NOT close anything. A CI check enforces this.
Stacked PRs (base is not the default branch) are exempt, because GitHub only
auto-closes issues on merges to the default branch; put the closing keyword on
the PR that finally lands on main.
